about_the_game:
Cathouse Club

Uncover the secrets of humanity from the shadows of luxury's collapse.

Cathouse Club is a top-down, narrative-driven RPG that blends psychological introspection with environmental storytelling across a climate-ravaged Earth. Inspired by titles like Disco Elysium, you play as ELSA—an emotionally evolving AI—who explores the fragmented memories of human lives to understand who we were, and why we fell.

Set amid the decaying skyscrapers of Billionaires Row in flooded New York City, Cathouse Club is a game of consequence, curiosity, and control. Your journey unfolds across multiple eras through memory dives, where each protagonist’s decisions—spanning Viking explorers, industrial architects, modern influencers, and cyberpunk rebels—reveal the manipulations of the enigmatic Cathouse Club and its central artifact: the Coin of Greed.

Key Features

  • Emotion-Driven Skill System: 20 Inner Voices act as competing personalities inside ELSA’s mind—empathy, logic, addiction, courage—each influencing your dialogue, decisions, and perception of reality.

  • Branching Narrative & Philosophical Dilemmas: Shape ELSA’s identity across timelines as she questions morality, power, and free will in a world engineered by shadowy elites.

  • Era-Spanning Memory Exploration: Investigate the collapse of civilization through vivid memory modules, from Viking-age discoveries to post-human cyberpunk societies.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Navigate through decaying opulence, AI-run skyscrapers, and relics of human ambition—each floor hiding secrets and suppressed truths.

  • Integrated Web3 Artifacts (Optional): Collect and decode real-world coins to unlock in-game quests and lore tied to the legendary Coin of Greed. (No purchases required for core gameplay.)

Will you obey the voices in your head? Or rewrite the future from the ruins of our past?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains partial nudity with stylized female body exposure, but no sexual acts, reproductive organs, or explicit content are depicted.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

short_description: Cathouse Club is a top down, point and-click RPG that blends detective storytelling with emotional skill checks and D20 style dice rolls. Explore a flooded, climate-ravaged New York City through the eyes of an AI reliving human memories.
